name: Recall
description: Spaced repetition over cards you write in notes (`front :: back`, `front ::: back` both ways, or a question, a line with ?, and its answer). Schedules each card on the forgetting curve (FSRS) and keeps your reviews in recall/log, so every device and the server's daily reminder agree.
author: AIDE

settings.title: Card folders
settings.help: Notes under these folders hold cards. Default: cards
